reply.subject: Larkspur demo: time windows for your pharmacy deliveries
reply.body:
Hi Mariana,

Thanks for the detail. Larkspur plans each day's routes around delivery time windows, so your pharmacy stops would be scheduled inside their windows. Drivers get their stops in a phone app, and dispatch is warned when a delivery is running late. That should take most of the nightly Excel work off your dispatcher.

For 62 vans the price is USD 180 per vehicle per year, invoiced up front. I'll confirm a realistic go-live timeline before December on our call.

Could you send me two or three times that suit you next week for a 30-minute demo using a sample of your pharmacy routes?

Best,
Ana Ruiz

reply.subject: Larkspur pricing
reply.body:
Hi Tom,

Larkspur costs USD 180 per vehicle per year, invoiced up front. It's built for delivery fleets of 5 vehicles or more. It plans each day's routes around delivery time windows, sends drivers their stops in a phone app and alerts dispatch when a delivery is running late. With one van and about 15 drops a day, most of that would be more than you need right now.

If your fleet grows toward 5 vehicles, reply to this email and we'll set you up with a walkthrough.

The Larkspur team

reply.subject: Empty routes for tomorrow at two depots
reply.body:
Hi Kenji,

Thanks for letting us know. We understand your drivers start at 6, so we're treating this as urgent.

To help us find the cause quickly, please reply with:
- the names of the two depots that are affected
- whether the routes also look empty in the dispatch view, or only in the driver app
- roughly when you last saw the routes appear correctly

Once we have these details, a member of our support team will contact you with an update.

The Larkspur team
